Firmware update

Install H9 Toolbox Firmware, or restore official v1.0.38, through the TD-H9 vendor HID recovery mode. H9 Toolbox Firmware is stock v1.0.38 plus an app loader: hold Back for a menu of apps (an onboard APRS client, Brick Breaker and more) that you add and remove in the App Manager, together with your boot logo. The package downloads from H9 Toolbox and is checked against its exact hash. Your radio backup stays in your browser and is never uploaded.

Before you begin

Install and restore through this page have been tested on one TD-H9 from macOS. A failed update can leave the radio unable to boot. Keep a reliable recovery method available.

Before writing, the page backs up the radio (Backup radio in step 03); keep that file. The HID backup reconstructs flash from CRC queries. On stock or H9 Toolbox firmware it takes a few seconds; on other firmware it can take about an hour. HID cannot read or write the protected first 0x5000 bytes. A Bluetooth channel .img is not a firmware recovery backup.

H9 Toolbox Firmware installs over the exact stock v1.0.38 main image, the original Brick Breaker, or any earlier H9 Toolbox Firmware build; the page refuses any other starting image. If you update older firmware to v1.0.38, recheck channels and settings afterward.

01

Connect radio

Disconnected
  1. Turn the radio off and connect a data-capable USB-C cable.
  2. Hold PTT + 2 while powering on. The screen stays blank and the top LED turns green.
  3. Click Connect radio and choose the JieLi HID device in the browser’s list.

Keep the radio connected in HID mode until you finish step 03.

02

Select firmware

✓ SelectedH9 Toolbox Firmware v0.1.5Includes the app loader, Bluetooth packet support and a staged APRS modem update. You can finish the modem update from the keypad in optional step 05.
✓ SelectedStock Type-C v1.0.38Reads the pinned ZIP from the third-party TDH9 mirror and verifies both the ZIP and extracted firmware hashes.

No firmware selected

You usually do not need a file here. If the radio runs stock, its backup is the restore point; if it runs any H9 Toolbox Firmware build or the original Brick Breaker, the restore point is official stock v1.0.38, rebuilt from verified files. Choose a file only for a radio with other firmware.

03

Write firmware

Click Backup radio and keep the downloaded recovery file. Install checks the radio before it writes. For H9 Toolbox Firmware, it also copies the APRS update into spare memory if the space is available. Keep USB connected until you see the final result.

Connect the radio in step 01.

Restore writes the main firmware from your backup. The staged file and APRS modem stay as they are. Use the Bluetooth programmer to back up channels and settings.

0%
04

Install apps and a boot logo

Bluetooth

Needs H9 Toolbox Firmware on the radio.

  1. If the radio is still in update mode, power-cycle it so it starts normally.
  2. Open the App Manager in this browser and connect over Bluetooth or experimental USB-C.
  3. Add apps (APRS, Brick Breaker…) and choose a boot logo, then Write to radio.
  4. On the radio, hold Back for the app menu.
Open the App Manager

Apps and the boot logo live on the radio’s separate resource flash, so firmware updates (including a return to stock) keep them.

05

Unlock KISS TNC

Optional

Use this step after Install confirms that the APRS update was staged.

  1. When the USB install finishes, unplug the cable and turn the radio off.
  2. Hold the side PTT (talk) button and the keypad 7 together while turning the radio on. Let go when the screen says APRS Update.
  3. Press Menu once and let go. At APRS STAGE READY, press Menu a second time to write the modem firmware. Leave the radio on until it shows APRS BOOT VERIFIED. Press Back from the ready screen if you want to leave without writing.
  4. Turn the radio off and back on normally. In APRS Info, look for V1.0.15X.
  5. Turn on Bluetooth on the radio. Download and unzip the bridge on your computer, open the README, and follow the steps to connect your packet program.
Download KISS bridge and README

The bridge connects the radio over Bluetooth and provides direct KISS TCP plus built-in AGWPE for Pat and Paracon. The ZIP includes setup instructions.

If APRS Info stays on Querying… after a normal restart, use the Windows APRS recovery instructions.
